articles.title: Why the Trump-backed crypto venture is distancing itself from Hong Kong AI aggregator WorldClaw
articles.snippet: WLFI says the AI platform is independent and uses USD1 as a payment rail, but would not say whether it has equity, financing, revenue-sharing or other economic interests in the company.

articles.title: OCC approves Trump family crypto company for trust charter
articles.snippet: The US financial regulator gave conditional approval for World Liberty Financial’s charter bid as ten Democrats signed onto a bill to “prevent corruption in banking applications.“

articles.title: Bitcoin hits $64K as gold gains while oil shakes off Trump Oman threat
articles.snippet: Bitcoin price strength saw BTC/USD pass $64,000 on 2% daily gains as gold pushed higher while US stocks wobbled on fresh US-Iran rhetoric.

articles.title: XRP Price Holds to Near Two-Year Streak, But Charts Flash a Warning Sign
articles.snippet: XRP is clinging to the dollar price line it's defended since Trump's 2024 win. But both the daily and weekly charts are now flashing red.

articles.title: Morning Minute: Trump To Meet Crypto, Prediction Market CEOs This Week
articles.snippet: The meeting comes while progress on the Clarity Act has been delayed and the SEC's latest rulemaking postponed.
